scripts.title: Monitors off
scripts.description: Turns every connected monitor off until you move the mouse or press a key. Nothing is locked or closed.

scripts.title: Lock and monitors off
scripts.description: Locks the PC, then switches the monitors off. Waking them shows the lock screen.

scripts.title: Brightness 20%
scripts.description: Dims the screen to 20% brightness.
scripts.note: Works on laptop panels. Most external monitors don't accept brightness commands from Windows.

scripts.title: Brightness 100%
scripts.description: Sets the screen to full brightness.
scripts.note: Works on laptop panels. Most external monitors don't accept brightness commands from Windows.

scripts.title: Night light toggle
scripts.description: Turns Night light (warm screen colours) on or off.
scripts.note: Edits an undocumented Windows setting, so a future Windows update could break it.

scripts.title: Dark mode toggle
scripts.description: Switches Windows and apps between dark and light mode.
scripts.note: Some apps that are already open only update after a restart.

scripts.title: Extend displays
scripts.description: Extends the desktop across all connected displays (Win+P, Extend).

scripts.title: Duplicate displays
scripts.description: Shows the same image on every display (Win+P, Duplicate).

scripts.title: Second screen only
scripts.description: Uses only the external display (Win+P, Second screen only).

scripts.title: PC screen only
scripts.description: Uses only the main display (Win+P, PC screen only).

scripts.title: Sleep now
scripts.description: Puts the PC to sleep right away.

scripts.title: Hibernate now
scripts.description: Hibernates the PC right away.
scripts.note: Hibernation must be enabled first (admin command: powercfg /hibernate on).

scripts.title: Restart now
scripts.description: Restarts the PC immediately, without a countdown.

scripts.title: Shut down in 30 minutes
scripts.description: Schedules a shutdown in 30 minutes. Handy for falling asleep to a video.

scripts.title: Cancel shutdown
scripts.description: Cancels a scheduled shutdown or restart.

scripts.title: Power plan: High performance
scripts.description: Switches to the High performance power plan.
scripts.note: Some laptops don't offer this plan. The script tells you if so.

scripts.title: Power plan: Balanced
scripts.description: Switches to the Balanced power plan.

scripts.title: Power plan: Power saver
scripts.description: Switches to the Power saver plan.
scripts.note: Some PCs don't offer this plan. The script tells you if so.

scripts.title: Stay awake
scripts.description: Stops the PC and screen from sleeping for as long as its window stays open. Press Enter or close the window to stop.

scripts.title: Mute toggle
scripts.description: Mutes or unmutes the system volume, like the keyboard mute key.

scripts.title: Volume 50%
scripts.description: Sets the volume to 50%.
scripts.note: Works by pressing the volume keys, so the volume pop-up flashes on screen.

scripts.title: Switch to headphones
scripts.description: Makes your headphones the default playback device.
scripts.note: Edit DEVICE at the top to match part of your device's name. Run List audio devices to see the names.

scripts.title: Switch to speakers
scripts.description: Makes your speakers the default playback device.
scripts.note: Edit DEVICE at the top to match part of your device's name. Run List audio devices to see the names.

scripts.title: List audio devices
scripts.description: Shows your active playback devices, so you know what to put in the switch scripts.

scripts.title: Wi-Fi off
scripts.description: Turns Wi-Fi off by disabling the adapter.
scripts.note: Assumes the adapter is named Wi-Fi. If yours isn't, edit ADAPTER (see: netsh interface show interface).

scripts.title: Wi-Fi on
scripts.description: Turns Wi-Fi back on by enabling the adapter.
scripts.note: Assumes the adapter is named Wi-Fi. If yours isn't, edit ADAPTER (see: netsh interface show interface).

scripts.title: Flush DNS
scripts.description: Clears the DNS cache. Often fixes a site that won't load after it moved servers.

scripts.title: Network reset
scripts.description: Releases and renews your IP address, flushes DNS and resets Winsock.
scripts.note: You'll drop offline for a few seconds. Restart the PC afterwards to finish the Winsock reset.

scripts.title: Show Wi-Fi password
scripts.description: Shows the saved password of the Wi-Fi network you're connected to.
scripts.note: Expects English Windows, because it reads the output of netsh.

scripts.title: Clear temp files
scripts.description: Empties your user temp folder. Files that are in use are skipped.

scripts.title: Restart Explorer
scripts.description: Restarts Windows Explorer. Fixes a frozen or glitchy taskbar and Start menu.

scripts.title: Close all browsers
scripts.description: Force-closes Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi.
scripts.note: Unsaved form data is lost. Most browsers offer to restore your tabs next time.

scripts.title: Focus mode on
scripts.description: Closes chat apps and turns off notification banners. Undo with Focus mode off.
scripts.note: Force-closes the apps listed in APPS at the top. Edit the list, and don't add apps where you might have unsaved work.

scripts.title: Focus mode off
scripts.description: Turns notification banners back on after Focus mode on.
scripts.note: If banners don't return straight away, sign out and back in.

scripts.title: Start work
scripts.description: Opens your usual work apps and websites in one go.
scripts.note: A template: edit it to list your own sites and apps.

scripts.title: Snip screen
scripts.description: Opens the screen snipping overlay (Win+Shift+S). The capture goes to the clipboard.

scripts.title: Desktop icons toggle
scripts.description: Shows or hides every icon on the desktop.
scripts.note: Restarts Explorer to apply it, so the taskbar flickers briefly.

scripts.title: Lock now
scripts.description: Locks the PC (Win+L).

scripts.title: Sign out
scripts.description: Signs you out right away.
scripts.note: Open apps are closed, so save your work first.

scripts.title: Restart to BIOS/UEFI
scripts.description: Restarts straight into the firmware setup screen after a 5 second countdown.
scripts.note: UEFI PCs only. Save your work first. Run Cancel shutdown within 5 seconds to abort.

scripts.title: Open Sound settings
scripts.description: Opens the Sound settings page for output and input devices and volume.

scripts.title: Open App volume
scripts.description: Opens App volume and device preferences, to set volume or output device per app.

scripts.title: Show IP address
scripts.description: Shows this PC's IPv4 address, default gateway and DNS servers for each adapter.

scripts.title: Internet check
scripts.description: Tells you whether a problem is your connection or DNS. Pings 1.1.1.1, then looks up one.one.one.one.

scripts.title: List Wi-Fi networks
scripts.description: Lists the Wi-Fi networks in range with their security type and signal strength.

scripts.title: System info
scripts.description: Shows Windows version, CPU, memory, uptime and free disk space on one screen.

scripts.title: Battery report
scripts.description: Builds a battery health report (design vs. current capacity, usage history) and opens it.
scripts.note: Meant for laptops. On a desktop PC the report opens but has no battery data.

scripts.title: Startup apps
scripts.description: Opens Settings > Apps > Startup, to switch off apps that launch when you sign in.

scripts.title: Windows Update
scripts.description: Opens Windows Update, ready to check for updates.

scripts.title: Disk Cleanup
scripts.description: Opens Windows' Disk Cleanup tool. It asks which drive to scan and what to delete.

scripts.title: Repair Windows
scripts.description: Repairs corrupted Windows files with DISM, then SFC.
scripts.note: Can take 10 to 30 minutes. DISM downloads repair files from Windows Update.

scripts.title: Empty Recycle Bin
scripts.description: Permanently empties the Recycle Bin on every drive, after asking you to confirm.
scripts.note: Deleted files can't be recovered.

scripts.title: Clear clipboard
scripts.description: Empties the clipboard, e.g. after copying a password.
scripts.note: Doesn't clear Windows clipboard history (Win+V).

scripts.title: Clear recent files
scripts.description: Clears the Recent files list in File Explorer and recent items in taskbar Jump Lists.

scripts.title: Environment variables
scripts.description: Opens the Environment Variables editor.

scripts.title: Startup folder
scripts.description: Opens your Startup folder. Shortcuts placed there run when you sign in.

scripts.title: Downloads folder
scripts.description: Opens your Downloads folder, even if you've moved it.

scripts.title: AppData folder
scripts.description: Opens your AppData\Roaming folder, where many apps keep their settings.

scripts.title: Device Manager
scripts.description: Opens Device Manager.

scripts.title: Services
scripts.description: Opens the Services list.

scripts.title: Edit hosts file
scripts.description: Opens the hosts file in Notepad with admin rights, so you can save changes.

scripts.title: All Tasks (God Mode)
scripts.description: Opens every Control Panel setting in one searchable list.

scripts.title: Focus timer: 25 minutes
scripts.description: Counts down 25 minutes, then pops up a message. Close the window to cancel.
scripts.note: Edit MINUTES at the top for a different length.

scripts.title: Break timer: 5 minutes
scripts.description: Counts down a 5 minute break, then pops up a message. Close the window to cancel.
scripts.note: Edit MINUTES at the top for a different length.

scripts.title: Minimize all windows
scripts.description: Minimizes every open window (Win+M). Undo with Restore windows.

scripts.title: Restore windows
scripts.description: Brings back the windows hidden by Minimize all (Win+Shift+M).
